en.quote: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.
en.riddle: The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.
en.speaker: governors of Judah

he.quote: וְאָֽמְרוּ אַלֻּפֵי יְהוּדָה בְּלִבָּם אַמְצָה לִי יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם בַּיהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם
he.riddle: אַמְצָה לִי יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם בַּיהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם
he.speaker: אַלֻּפֵי יְהוּדָה
